title: What Bike Bar Captains Know That Your Group Chat Doesn't
why: Slippery-slide insider list for planners who want to look like they've done this before; specific, checkable captain knowledge from the SOPs and live tour pages.
hook_options: Things our captains know that your group chat doesn't.
The bike bar has rules nobody tells you. Here they are.
Six things you only learn after a dozen rides.
caption: Stuff our captains know that never makes it into the group chat: the safety talk is about 90 seconds, STOP means stop, the brewery tour hits up to three breweries, and there's a 300-year mural wall on Tchoupitoulas most visitors never see. Save it for your planner. #neworleans #irishchannel #nolabrewery #thingstodoinneworleans

slides.headline: What your captain knows that your group chat doesn't
The safety talk takes about 90 seconds
slides.body: Stay seated, hands in, hold on at stops. Then the captain flips to party mode. Listen once, ride free.

slides.headline: STOP is a real command
slides.body: Bathroom, somebody feels rough, anything. Shout it and the captain pulls over as soon as it's safe.

slides.headline: The captain is your designated driver
slides.body: Nobody in your group steers, brakes, or worries about parking. That's the whole point.

slides.headline: The brewery tour hits up to three breweries
slides.body: Irish Channel, about two hours, starting at Port Orleans Brewing on Tchoupitoulas.

slides.headline: There's a 300-year story on a floodwall
slides.body: The Tchoupitoulas mural wall tells New Orleans history in panels. Most visitors drive right past it.

slides.headline: Captains know where the potholes are
slides.body: Which streets rattle your drink, which corners wave back, where construction popped up this week.

slides.headline: Partner bars run drink specials for riders
slides.body: Ask your captain where tonight's deal is before the first stop.

slides.headline: Listen once. Shout STOP. Ask about the murals.
slides.body: And let the captain handle the streets.

slides.headline: Ride with someone who knows the block
slides.body: Brewery tour or Mid-City. Book at nolabikebar.com.
